name: RushVue SEO AI Search Readiness
author: ronnie85

sections.description:
RushVue is a lightweight, modern SEO plugin built for today’s web.

Instead of overwhelming users with hundreds of settings, RushVue focuses on the features that matter most for modern search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.

The built-in AI Search Readiness Score analyzes your website and provides actionable recommendations to improve visibility across Google, Bing, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and other AI search systems.

The AI Search Readiness Score is calculated locally on your WordPress site. RushVue does not send your page or post content to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI, Bing, Perplexity, or any other AI API.

Free Features

  • AI Search Readiness Dashboard
  • SEO Titles & Meta Descriptions
  • Open Graph Metadata
  • Twitter Cards
  • XML Sitemap
  • Organization Schema
  • Image ALT Tag Generator
  • llms.txt Generator
  • Redirect Manager (exact redirects)
  • 404 Error Monitor
  • AI Search Engine Compatibility Checker
  • Modern WordPress Admin Interface

Premium Features

  • Bulk SEO Editor
  • WooCommerce SEO
  • Product Schema
  • Advanced Schema Types
  • Local SEO
  • Regex Redirects
  • Automatic Slug Redirects
  • Premium Support

Why RushVue?

Unlike traditional SEO plugins that focus only on search engines, RushVue is designed for the evolving landscape of AI-powered search.

Its unique AI Search Readiness Dashboard helps identify opportunities that improve your site’s visibility for both search engines and AI assistants.

External Services

RushVue’s Free features (including AI Search Readiness and the local llms.txt probe) run on your WordPress site. The llms.txt accessibility check requests your own site URL and is not a third-party AI service.

RushVue uses one third-party service:

Freemius

Freemius (api.freemius.com / freemius.com) is used for:

  • Licensing and account connection for RushVue Pro
  • Premium feature entitlement checks
  • Optional SDK-related telemetry when a site administrator opts in or connects an account
  • Premium plugin update distribution where applicable (Pro builds)

Depending on administrator actions (opt-in, account connection, license activation, or Freemius-managed update checks), Freemius may receive information such as:

  • Site URL / homepage URL and site title
  • WordPress and PHP versions, site language
  • Plugin and Freemius SDK versions and activation state
  • Administrator name and email when connecting or activating a license
  • License keys and related licensing metadata when activating Pro
  • A list of installed plugins/themes (names, slugs, versions, active state) when opted in for compatibility insights

Transmission can occur when an administrator opts into Freemius connectivity, connects or activates a license, manages the Freemius account screen, or when the SDK performs licensing/update-related requests for applicable builds. With anonymous/skip mode, the Free plugin remains usable without requiring opt-in; optional connectivity remains available through Freemius UI.

Freemius is a third-party service operated by Freemius Inc.

  • Terms of Service: https://freemius.com/terms/
  • Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Complete the RushVue Setup Wizard.
  4. Review your AI Search Readiness Score.
  5. Follow the recommendations to improve your score.
sections.faq:
Will RushVue work alongside other SEO plugins?

It is recommended to use only one SEO plugin at a time to avoid duplicate metadata and schema.

Does RushVue support AI search engines?

Yes.

RushVue includes features designed to improve compatibility with modern AI-powered search platforms, including llms.txt generation, Organization Schema, metadata optimization, and an AI Search Readiness assessment. The readiness assessment runs locally and does not send your content to external AI providers.

Does RushVue slow down my website?

No.

RushVue is designed to be lightweight and follows WordPress coding standards while minimizing unnecessary processing.

What happens to my data if I uninstall RushVue?

By default, RushVue keeps your settings and custom database tables when the plugin is uninstalled so you can reinstall without losing configuration.

In RushVue → General Settings you can optionally enable “Delete plugin data when uninstalling”. When that option is enabled, uninstall removes:

  • Custom tables: {prefix}nova_seo_redirects and {prefix}nova_seo_404_logs
  • Plugin options (general, titles, sitemap, schema-related, wizard/onboarding state, version markers, and the delete-data preference itself)
  • Related transients used for activation redirect and llms.txt validation

If the option is left disabled (the default), those options and tables remain after uninstall.

Freemius account/license data is managed separately by the Freemius SDK according to Freemius’s own uninstall handling and is not controlled by the RushVue delete-data checkbox.
